status_effects.explanation: Being singled out for a warm, musical greeting by a princess momentarily includes the narrator in valued aristocratic company.
Saint-Loup's charm and reputed fidelity win him admiring prestige among these women, netting a mild positive local appraisal despite an undercurrent of mockery.

appraisal_events.evidence: Elle me reconnut, inclina la tête en souriant; très au-dessus de ce salut, émanant de ce mouvement même, s'élevèrent mélodieusement quelques paroles à mon adresse
appraisal_events.explanation: The princess singles out the narrator with a recognition and greeting so gracious it exceeds ordinary politeness, staging him as favorably included in her elite company.

appraisal_events.evidence: l'indifférence qu'on lui savait pour toute femme qui n'était pas son actrice lui donnait aux yeux de celles-ci un prestige singulier; « Quel joli garçon ! ... quel chic ! ... Il faut qu'il soit tout de même une fameuse truffe. »
appraisal_events.explanation: The women at Rivebelle admire Saint-Loup's looks and his known fidelity to his mistress, granting him a singular prestige, while their gossip also mocks him as foolish for that devotion.
